title: Google Schemer
text: I contributed JavaScript and Flash development to Start Scheming, a promotional site for Google Schemer. Schemer helped people discover and share things to do; the campaign gave them a photo activity to try. Visitors could upload a picture or use a webcam, align the image, and shape a mustache using control points. A style selector offered different looks. The guided editor turned Schemer’s mustache motif into a personalized portrait, keeping the campaign focused on something visitors could make themselves.
summary: I contributed JavaScript and Flash development to Start Scheming, a Google Schemer promotional experience where visitors could create a mustache portrait from a photo.
